general.name: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search
general.description: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.

general.name: akitaonrails/ai-memory
general.description: Solution for long term memory for agent coding CLIs and to facilitate handoff between different agent vendors
general.description_zh: 用于 agent 编程 CLI 长期记忆并促进不同 agent 厂商间交接的解决方案

general.name: Comfy-Org/ComfyUI
general.description: The most powerful and modular diffusion model GUI, api and backend with a graph/nodes interface. The fastest local inference engine in the world.

general.name: ruvnet/ruflo
general.description: 🌊 The original agent harness. Deploy intelligent multi-player swarms, coordinate autonomous workflows, and build conversational AI systems. Features adaptive memory, self-learning intelligence, federation, vector RAG integration, and native Claude Code / Codex / Hermes and many more Integrated

general.name: stablyai/orca
general.description: Orca is the place for working with a fleet of agents (e.g. Grok Bot, Claude Code). Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

general.name: headroomlabs-ai/headroom
general.description: Compress tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM. 20% fewer tokens for coding agents, 60-95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. Library, proxy, MCP server.
general.description_zh: 在工具输出、日志、文件和 RAG 分块进入 LLM 前进行压缩。编程 agent 减少 20% token，JSON 减少 60-95% token，答案不变。提供库、代理和 MCP server。

general.name: HKUDS/CLI-Anything
general.description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/
general.description_zh: "CLI-Anything：让所有软件 Agent 原生化" —— CLI-Hub：https://clianything.cc/

general.name: anthropics/claude-code
general.description: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase, and helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, explaining complex code, and handling git workflows - all through natural language commands.
general.description_zh: Claude Code 是一款驻留在终端中的智能编码工具，能够理解你的代码库，通过自然语言命令执行日常任务、解释复杂代码、处理 git 工作流，帮助你更快地编写代码。
features: 终端内运行的 agentic 编码工具，通过自然语言命令操作代码库
自动执行常规任务、解释复杂代码并处理 git 工作流
支持终端、IDE 使用，或在 GitHub 中 @claude 触发
提供插件机制，通过自定义命令和 agents 扩展功能
内置 /bug 命令用于直接反馈问题

general.name: shiyu-coder/Kronos
general.description: Kronos: A Foundation Model for the Language of Financial Markets
general.description_zh: Kronos：金融市场语言的基础模型
features: 面向金融 K 线数据预训练的首个开源 decoder-only 基础模型
通过专用 tokenizer 将 OHLCV 数据量化为分层离散 token
基于全球 45+ 交易所数据预训练的自回归 Transformer 模型
提供微调脚本，可适配自定义量化任务
支持 Hugging Face 模型加载与在线 Demo 体验
